description: A unified machine-learning engineering toolkit spanning dataset quality, model development, hyperparameter optimization, MLOps pipelines, deployment, monitoring, and rollback.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me take this machine-learning task from data quality and model development through evaluation, reproducible pipelines, safe deployment, and monitoring. State assumptions, prevent leakage, and never invent metrics or claim unverified execution.
interface.longDescription: One unified toolkit for reliable machine-learning work: audit datasets and labels, develop and evaluate models, tune hyperparameters, design reproducible ML pipelines, deploy safely, and monitor production behavior with explicit rollout and rollback criteria.

name: ml-engineering-suite
